data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2023 were GBP 3,299.7m. During 2023 the syndicate recorded a gross prior-year strengthening of GBP 87.3m (approx. 2.65% of opening gross reserves) in the movement in prior year claims provision. Concurrently the syndicate executed a transaction to reinsure certain prior-year claims liabilities which produced additional reinsurance recoveries and a positive net impact on the reported profit, reducing net claims incurred. No quantification by individual LOB for the gross prior-year movement is provided in the notes; named 2023 catastrophe events (Turkey earthquake, Hawaii Wildfires, Hurricane Idalia, Cyclone Gabrielle) were reported as being within planned catastrophe loss allowances.
raw_causal_phrases: During the current period, the Syndicate entered into a transaction to reinsure certain prior year claims liabilities.
The transaction had a positive net impact on the reported profit for the financial year.
The associated additional reinsurance recoveries have reduced the reported net claims incurred.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year gross movement taken from Technical Provisions note (Claims expense - previous year = 87.3 gross). The report also describes a retrospective reinsurance transaction that increased reinsurance recoveries (reinsurers' share -264.4) yielding a net release of -177.1; gross and net movements are therefore in opposite directions. No LOB-level gross prior-year movements are provided. Claims development triangle is present and was used as supplemental evidence but rows have differing maturities; alignment of triangle columns to underwriting years required inference. Where ambiguity existed between gross and net figures, gross figures were preferred per instructions.
